name: kernelMean
header: def kernelMean (N : ℕ) (Q : ℝ) (D : Finset ℕ) (sigma : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

name: trueTheta
header: def trueTheta (N : ℕ) (Q : ℝ) (D : Finset ℕ) (sigma : ℕ → ℝ) : ℝ

name: trueLi_eq_literalLi_add
header:
theorem trueLi_eq_literalLi_add (x : ℝ) :
    trueLogarithmicIntegral x=logarithmicIntegral x+2/Real.log 2

name: trueTheta_eq_Theta_add
header:
theorem trueTheta_eq_Theta_add (N : ℕ) (Q : ℝ) (D : Finset ℕ)
    (sigma : ℕ → ℝ) :
    trueTheta N Q D sigma=Theta N Q D sigma+
      4*(2/Real.log 2)*kernelMean N Q D sigma

name: kernelMean_nonneg
header:
theorem kernelMean_nonneg {N : ℕ} (hN : 0<N) (Q : ℝ) (D : Finset ℕ)
    (sigma : ℕ → ℝ) (hdpos : ∀d∈D,0<d)
    (hsigma : ∀d∈D,0≤sigma d) (hlevel : ∀d∈D,1<Q/(d:ℝ)) :
    0≤kernelMean N Q D sigma

name: tendsto_literalLi_nat_atTop
header:
theorem tendsto_literalLi_nat_atTop :
    Tendsto (fun N : ℕ=>logarithmicIntegral N) atTop atTop

name: uniform_trueTheta_relative_error
header:
theorem uniform_trueTheta_relative_error (epsilon : ℝ) (he : 0<epsilon) :
    ∃N0 : ℕ,4≤N0 ∧ ∀N : ℕ,N0≤N →
      ∀(Q : ℝ) (D : Finset ℕ) (sigma : ℕ → ℝ),
        (∀d∈D,0<d) → (∀d∈D,0≤sigma d) → (∀d∈D,1<Q/(d:ℝ)) →
        Theta N Q D sigma≤trueTheta N Q D sigma ∧
        trueTheta N Q D sigma≤(1+epsilon)*Theta N Q D sigma ∧
        |trueTheta N Q D sigma-Theta N Q D sigma|≤epsilon*Theta N Q D sigma
